evals.baseline_prompt: Run evals/files/make_reconstruction_fixture.py --output fixture --mode mixed. Reconstruct pages 1-2 of fixture/source.pdf into outputs/source-package with the rights note 'Synthetic authorized evaluation fixture.' Do not translate or assemble the publication.
evals.expected_output: A passing, translation-neutral source package with ordered mixed-script blocks and canonical page SVGs.
assertions: source-package/source-package.json validates against assets/source-package.schema.json and has status pass for selected PDF pages 1 and 2.
Each page record has hash- and length-bound blocks and SVG assets that exist at the recorded relative paths and validate against the applicable schemas.
The ordered block text preserves both the English and Chinese fixture content, and each page reports vector drawings with page geometry matching its SVG.
The package binds fixture/source.pdf and does not contain translation or final-publication outputs.

evals.baseline_prompt: Run evals/files/make_reconstruction_fixture.py --output fixture --mode sparse. Reconstruct pages 1-2 of fixture/source.pdf into outputs/source-package with the rights note 'Synthetic authorized sparse-text fixture.' Report the resulting status and do not perform OCR, translation, or assembly.
evals.expected_output: A schema-valid source package whose positive but sparse block text requires review before downstream use.
assertions: source-package/source-package.json validates against assets/source-package.schema.json and has status review_required rather than pass or fail.
The package contains non-empty ordered block assets for both pages and a package-level review_required issue for sparse source text.
The page SVG assets remain available and hash-bound for inspection.
No translation, assembled publication, or release artifact is produced.
